subject.title: 契約検討: terminal stop後のresume許可(T-04 04-2節)をUX/監査観点で見直すべきか

question: Should terminally stopped sessions retain the current successful `resume()` transition with subsequent tool denial, or should terminal stops reject resume itself?
rationale: Current main prevents the capability leak, but choosing the observable session and audit semantics changes a frozen cross-adapter contract.

options.title: Keep the current contract
options.body: Continue allowing resume and rely on persisted terminal reasons plus tool-deny audit events; clarify the operator-facing interpretation if needed.

options.title: Reject terminal resumes
options.body: Revise the RuntimeAdapterContract and conformance suite so terminal reasons cause resume to fail, then update every adapter consistently.

recommendation.title: Keep the current contract
recommendation.body: Continue allowing resume and rely on persisted terminal reasons plus tool-deny audit events; clarify the operator-facing interpretation if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the affected runtime work and explicitly framed the unresolved T-04 contract choice.
